result.summary: The image depicts a wide one-way urban street with a marked zebra crosswalk and continuous sidewalks. While basic pedestrian infrastructure like curb ramps is present, the environment lacks traffic calming measures and dedicated pedestrian signals, potentially leading to higher vehicle speeds and increased exposure for those crossing.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The zebra stripes are worn, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.

hazards.name: Wide One-Way Roadway
hazards.description: The wide, multi-lane one-way configuration can encourage higher vehicle speeds and increases pedestrian exposure.

hazards.name: Sight Line Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles near the intersection may obscure pedestrians from the view of oncoming drivers.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions

result.summary: The image shows a wide urban intersection with mixed-use buildings and basic pedestrian infrastructure. While sidewalks, curb ramps, and pedestrian signals are present, the crosswalk markings are significantly faded and the crossing distance is substantial, increasing pedestrian exposure.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The transverse crosswalk markings are heavily worn, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway requires pedestrians to be exposed to traffic for a significant duration without a refuge island.

hazards.description: Parked vehicles near the intersection corners may block the view between pedestrians and turning drivers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Replace faded transverse lines with continental or ladder-style high-visibility markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance, improve sightlines, and slow turning traffic.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalks to ensure clear sightlines between pedestrians and motorists.

result.summary: The intersection features marked zebra crosswalks and sidewalks, but lacks dedicated pedestrian signal heads and curb extensions. The presence of parked vehicles near the crossing and the multi-lane configuration increase exposure and reduce visibility for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Lack of visible pedestrian signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are clearly visible, requiring pedestrians to rely on vehicle traffic lights which may not provide adequate clearance time.

hazards.name: Sightline obstruction from parked cars
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the crosswalk on the right side of the image obstruct the view between approaching drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.

interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines for both drivers and pedestrians.
